title: Add cohort entropy-slew detector and gradual holdback policy
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: We observed transient regressions where model outputs remain within historical accuracy bounds but exhibit rapid shifts in token-level entropy over short windows (an "entropy slew"). These events often precede visible quality degradation for prompt cohorts but aren't caught by existing pointwise regression gates. This PR introduces a cohort-level entropy-slew detector and a configurable gradual holdback policy to reduce blast radius when a high-velocity entropy change is detected.

Design summary:
1) EntropySlewDetector: computes short-window and baseline entropy distributions per prompt cohort, estimates a localized slope (delta-entropy / delta-time) and normalizes by historical interquartile range to produce a standardized slew score.
2) HoldbackPolicy: when a cohort exceeds a configurable slew threshold, we apply a staged holdback that (a) throttles traffic to the candidate model for that cohort, (b) routes a fraction to a stable fallback model, and (c) escalates to a soft quarantine if the condition persists.
3) CI hook + smokecheck integration: add an eval-harness CI hook that runs on PRs touching prompt sets or inference metric code; it simulates cohort traffic traces (synthetic and sampled) and validates slew metrics against historical baselines.

Implementation notes:
- New modules: eval_harness/hooks/entropy_slew_detector.py (detector + helpers), eval_harness/policies/gradual_holdback.py (policy and config), tests/test_entropy_slew_detector.py (unit and property tests), tests/integration/test_holdback_rollout.yml (integration smoke scenarios), docs/eval/entropy_slew.md (operator guide).
- Backcompat: by default the detector is disabled; enabling requires feature flag "enable_entropy_slew_detector" in eval-config.
- Configuration: supports cohort window lengths, baseline lookback ranges, slew z-score thresholds, and a three-step holdback schedule (10% -> 50% -> 100%).

Testing and validation:
- Unit tests cover edge cases (zero-entropy tokens, variable-length cohorts).
- Integration tests simulate bursty traffic and validate that routed traffic fractions match policy config.
- Ran the CI smoke suite on a representative 24-hour prompt cohort sample: no false positives at conservative thresholds; a synthetic injected regression triggered the holdback path as expected.

Rollout plan:
1) Merge as feature-flagged behind default-off toggles.
2) Enable in staging for 48h with monitoring dashboards (entropy-slew per-cohort timeseries, holdback events, failed-case samplers).
3) If stable, enable in canary with 5% traffic on production for 72h.
4) Full enable after 14-day observation window with no spurious holds.

Related items: ENG-1298 (cohort stability task), ENG-1310 (CI hook additions).
